sections.content: nagyon ('very') intensifies an adjective and goes right before it: nagyon kedves (very kind), nagyon erős (very strong). ismerős (acquaintance) and kicsi (small) round out the unit's vocabulary.
sections.title: Intensifying an adjective

sections.content: barát (friend) and ismerős (acquaintance) aren't interchangeable — ismerős is someone you merely know, not a close friend.
